'''Pokémon Adventures: Pikachu's New Partner''' is the nineteenth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters one and two of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|4}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
